types.description: TeSys D 3-pole contactor / AC-3 38 A (18.5 kW / 400 V) / 24 V DC low-consumption 'BL' coil / 1 NO + 1 NC integral auxiliary

document.title: Schneider Electric LC1D38BL product data sheet
document.pages: 1-3; applicable B8/8, B8/24 and B8/79 catalogue and 137830401A55 instruction are cited in modelingNotes

modelingNotes: Manufacturer exact reference LC1D38BL matches source order LC1-D38BL; the source presentation hyphen is retained. Exact historical product sheet, not a successor, establishes the BL 24 VDC low-consumption coil, 3NO main poles and factory 1NO+1NC auxiliary.

Applicable manufacturer contact diagram: https://iportal2.schneider-electric.com/Contents/docs/B8_CONTACTORS_EN_CATALOGUE.PDF , physical B8/79, LC1D09-D150 three-pole scheme linked to the exact B8/8 selection row. Main pairs 1/L1-2/T1, 3/L2-4/T2 and 5/L3-6/T3 are NO; factory auxiliary 13/NO-14 is NO and 21/NC-22 is NC.

Coil A1 is positive and A2 negative. Applicable historical LC1D instruction https://docs.rs-online.com/27c0/A700000008089423.pdf (137830401A55-10; printed W9 1378304 0211 A09, 03/2017), page 1, explicitly depicts A1+ and A2- and includes LC low-consumption scope. The later A14 instruction corroborates the marks. Bidirectional suppression does not imply arbitrary coil polarity; BD-only FAQ and separate PLC-interface reverse-polarity protection are not used as BL proof.

Aliases are documented textual labels, not extra terminals: A1+ means A1; A2- means A2; 13/NO means 13; 21/NC means 21. Main keys retain their combined numeric/line-load markings. The current terminal schema has no alias field, so these mappings are stated here and in terminal descriptions.

Exact LC1D38BL product sheet page 3: 2.4 W inrush and holding at 20 C; operation 0.8-1.25 Uc and dropout 0.1-0.3 Uc at 60 C, time constant 40 ms. The adjacent standard-DC 0.7 Uc lower limit and generic selection-table comparisons are not substituted for this exact-order data.

Built-in bidirectional peak-limiting diode suppression is fitted as standard. B8/24 expressly includes DC low-consumption coils: the suppressor is removable/replaceable, and clipping makes the electrical connection. The catalogue lists LAD4TBDL for 24 VDC and LAD9DL blanking plug if operated without suppression. The installed unit has not been inspected.

Physical coverage is partial beyond the established twelve field screw terminals. The installation diagram depicts the removable suppressor's two unnumbered accessory mating ends; their individual bindings are not enumerated. They are not extra field screw terminals. Schneider FAQ FA95490 https://www.se.com/us/en/faqs/FA95490/ confirms one A1 and one A2; no duplicated A2 is inferred. Optional LAD4BB coil-wiring adapter, other add-ons and their terminals are excluded.

The coil, clamp and moving contacts are not permanent net joins. Coil actuation is mechanical/functional only. No fixed links, protective-earth terminal, shield or communication port are asserted for this field-terminal model.

Required A1/A2 is an explicit library policy for the modeled operating contactor. Main and auxiliary contact usage is project-dependent; required does not claim that every unused stored device must be energized.

Conditional main ratings: 38 A AC-3 or 50 A AC-1 at <=440 VAC and <=60 C; 18.5 kW at 380-400 VAC, AC-3. Maximum main operating voltage <=690 VAC at 25-400 Hz or <=300 VDC, and insulation ratings, are capabilities rather than terminal nominal voltages. Power and signal thermal limits remain separate; exact auxiliary minimum signal is 17 V/5 mA. Coil nominal is genuinely 24 VDC.

connectionCoverage.notes: All twelve field-wiring terminals and six schematic functions are established: six main, four factory auxiliary, and one A1+ / one A2-. The standard removable suppressor has two unnumbered accessory mating ends that are not individually mapped or modeled. This is partial coverage of all physical electrical interfaces, not a missing field screw or unresolved coil polarity. No fixed continuity through coil, suppression or moving contacts is claimed; optional add-ons and as-built suppressor state are outside scope.

13.description: Factory auxiliary NO terminal; manufacturer marking 13/NO is the documented alias of key 13.

21.description: Factory auxiliary NC terminal; manufacturer marking 21/NC is the documented alias of key 21.

A1.description: 24 VDC low-consumption coil positive; manufacturer A1+ is the polarity-labelled alias of A1 (137830401A55 instruction, page 1).

A2.description: 24 VDC low-consumption coil negative; manufacturer A2- is the polarity-labelled alias of A2 (137830401A55 instruction, page 1).
